review_notes: Final 45 previously untouched entries from the C496 cleanup census. Exact local-substitution token checks cover 34 definitions; focused review covers 11 structured definitions. Larger parser, payment, mass-action, control and modal paths retain their existing flow.

Deadbox reanimation preserves fresh slot reads after classification calls and advances the slot before the reanimation callback. Attacker unlinking preserves linked-attacker bookkeeping and the final singleton fixup.

Exiled CMC counting preserves owner-bit tests, pointer comparison against paired records, fresh reads after CMC callbacks, and the original twenty-bin counting bound despite its twenty-one-entry buffer. Text copying preserves its clamp and trailing-row behavior; file-cache fallback indexing remains unchanged.

Song of the Dryads retains type conversion and attached ability masking. Titania, Crypt Sliver, Magma Sliver, Savage Summonings and Monstrosity retain callback order and cleanup gates. One combined incremental build; inventories, full historical audits and reccmp remain deferred.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
